record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: For generic homogeneous forms f1,...,fr of prescribed degrees a1,...,ar, determine the generic initial ideal, with respect to reverse lexicographic order, of the ideal (f1,...,fr).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an infinite field and let $S = k[x_1, \ldots, x_n]$ be the polynomial ring in $n$ variables, graded by total degree. Fix positive integers $r$ and $a_1, \ldots, a_r$. For homogeneous polynomials $f_1, \ldots, f_r \in S$ with $\deg f_i = a_i$, let $I = (f_1, \ldots, f_r)$. Consider the graded reverse lexicographic monomial order on $S$ (with $x_1 > x_2 > \cdots > x_n$), and let $\mathrm{gin}(I)$ denote the generic initial ideal of $I$ with respect to this order, that is, the initial ideal of $g \cdot I$ for a generic element $g$ of $\mathrm{GL}_n(k)$ acting on $S$.

For a "generic" choice of the forms $f_1, \ldots, f_r$ (i.e., for $(f_1, \ldots, f_r)$ in a Zariski-dense open subset of the space of $r$-tuples of forms of degrees $a_1, \ldots, a_r$), give an explicit description of the monomial ideal $\mathrm{gin}(I) \subset S$ as a function of $n$, $r$, and the degree sequence $(a_1, \ldots, a_r)$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is the Moreno-Socías conjecture, which predicts that the generic initial ideal of a generic ideal under graded reverse lex is a specific weakly reverse-lexicographic ideal (which would also imply Fröberg's conjecture on Hilbert series). It is proved for n=2 (Moreno-Socías; Aguirre–Jouanolou–Mourrain et al.), n=3 (Cimpoeaș), n=4 (Harima–Wachi), and for degree sequences satisfying d_i > Σ(d_j − i + 1) (Cho–Park). The general case remains open, with recent work (e.g., 2025 preprints) studying variations and additional partial cases.

status_evidence.title: Initial ideals of generic ideals and variations of Moreno-Socías conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Moreno-Socías conjectured that the initial ideal of a generic ideal with respect to graded reverse lex is weakly reverse lexicographic; proved in cases n=2,3,4 and for certain degree sequences.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture is proven in special cases but remains open in general.

status_evidence.title: Generic ideals and Moreno-Socías conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the conjecture describing the generic initial ideal of a generic ideal in the rev-lex order.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes partial results toward the conjectured description.
